title: 19-BCV-025 - Engineer authentication for the qualification of structural steel fabricators

facts.text: The variance offers an alternative route for qualifying structural-steel fabricators who are not CSA W47.1-certified, including fabrication outside Canada for installation in Alberta.
facts.locator: 19-BCV-025 PDF, pp. 1–2, Purpose, Discussion, and Application

facts.text: The owner is responsible for authentication of the welding program, including review of procedures by a registered engineering professional knowledgeable in welding.
facts.locator: Same PDF, pp. 2 and 5, Application and Variance

facts.text: Conditions include a Quality Management System, a Welding Program covering qualified procedures/welders and supervision/consumables, and submission of authenticated documents to the AHJ.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
